devdoc.details: WHY A CLONE, AND NOT A GAME ID INSIDE ONE CONTRACT. Everything a      client keys by is the game contract's address already (the stored      submission, the delegation, the indexer, a reveal service's slot), so      a game at an address of its own needs nothing new of any of them. A      game id would rewrite every one, the stored secret of a commitment      among them, which is a wire. A full deployment per game would work too,      and costs every route's code again.      THE CONFIG IS THE IMPLEMENTATION'S. A game's rules (its durations, its      policy, its chunk) are immutables baked into its routes, so every      clone of one implementation plays by the same ones; a different config      is a different implementation, and a factory of its own.
